conclusion.0x0CA: Supersede the old upper/lower/result-triplet interpretation; 0x0CA remains other protected longitudinal/chassis state.
conclusion.integration: For Camry, do not revive 0x160 Alpha Long. The OEM-native integration target is the TSS application/request side feeding Toyota's Vehicle Movement Manager. 0x08A is the strongest observed request-side carrier, while the downstream Vehicle Motion Control target interface and source-suppression/security path remain to be recovered.
conclusion.not_fully_mapped: The 5280/5281 recorder model is not fully byte-mapped. B6 retains the current ID/allocation interpretation, while the lower requester ID/allocation, shift/EPB, override-prohibition and priority remain unknown. B7-derived active/hold/override application-ID conclusions are withdrawn.
conclusion.request_plane: 0x08A is the observed continuous TSS request-side envelope. Signed16 B8:B9/B11:B12 acceleration slots and B6 request-ID/allocation interpretation are retained. B7 is the Toyota checksum, not a second request-ID/allocation byte. Recorder geometry does not prove a CAN mapping; exact internal application-selection placement remains unresolved.
conclusion.result_plane: 0x081 is the unified Brake-owned employed-result/reference/supervision envelope: its lateral selected ID/reference are recovered, B6[5:0] is the strongest 5284 longitudinal employed-source-ID candidate, and B20:B21 is observed as the closed-accelerator reference word with its former 57DB result-acceleration join retired by the 2026-09-30 cross-state corpus. In that corpus B4:B5 is the effective/result acceleration candidate and B18:B19 the drive result/reference, with no confirmed OEM diagnostic join for either. Current status and evidence: docs/variants/camry-2026-longitudinal-evidence.md#2026-09-30-vmc-status-corpus and data/generated/camry_20260930_vmc_status/.

gts_vehicle_motion_control_surface.interpretation: 0x10A1..0x10A4 are Toyota-Safety-Sense request acceleration/IDs; 0x10A5..0x10AA are Vehicle-Motion-Control target acceleration/IDs/driving force. This preserves the request -> post-arbitration request-generation boundary in Toyota diagnostics.

hold_request_semantics.interpretation: Delayed hold is measured by B4[5] with the cruise latch set. Raw B6/B7 pairs are retained observations, not two request-ID/allocation slots: B7 is the checksum. B6 allocation changes with accelerator override; B7 changes also reflect header flags, so its former ID17/ID25 distinction has no application-ID meaning. The exact OEM recorder identity of B4[5] remains unknown.

requester_id_namespace.boundary: Diagnostic/recorder and CAN namespaces are distinct. Numeric coincidences across axes or platforms do not establish application identity. Former B7-derived ID4/17/25/36 observations and associated baseline/hold/startup application attributions are withdrawn.
